description: This file defines the class SSMEcuInit, which implements the EcuInit interface. It appears to be related to initializing or handling ECU (Engine Control Unit) data for the RomRaider open-source tuning project. The class extracts an ECU ID from a byte array and provides accessors for raw ECU initialization bytes and the parsed ID.

classes.name: SSMEcuInit
classes.description: Class representing an ECU initialization object, extracting an ECU ID from a byte array and providing related accessors.

methods.name: SSMEcuInit
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with ECU bytes and extracts the ECU ID.

methods.name: getEcuId
methods.description: Returns the extracted ECU ID as a String.

methods.name: getEcuInitBytes
methods.description: Returns the raw ECU initialization bytes.
